name: huddle-loom

scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.deploy:dry: pnpm build && pnpm exec wrangler deploy --dry-run

CATALOG.description: D1 stores folders, workbooks, board metadata, and archive records. It is provisioned automatically on the first deployment.

BLOBS.description: R2 stores images and other content-addressed whiteboard assets. It is provisioned automatically on the first deployment.

BOARD_ROOMS.description: The Durable Object keeps live board state, revisions, and synchronization. It is created during Worker deployment.

SETUP_PASSWORD.description: Choose a private setup password (at least 15 characters). Enter it once on the welcome screen to create your administrator account. This is not an API key.

INSTALLATION_KEYS.description: Keeps automatically generated sign-in and encryption keys private and stable across updates. Provisioned automatically.

EMAIL.description: Native Cloudflare email connection. Approve your sending domain and confirm a test email in Huddle Loom when you are ready. Accounts and private invitations work before email is enabled.

description: A self-hosted whiteboard for shared ideas and editable workflows.
